content:
Anya: Heads-up — design question: do we expose tenant SLO cost as a single expected burn per-interval or a distribution (p50/p95)?
Matt: my vote: both. quick column for expected + small sparkline for variance. p95 useful for budgeting.
Lisa: also need cache-savings attribution. tenants should see 'claimed cache credits' vs 'observed savings'. right now we only show net token delta.
Samir: cc @Anya + @Matt — how would we compute claimed credits? per-session prefetch mapping? that mapping is messy.
Anya: idea: emit two telemetry signals per invocation: raw_token_cost, cache_credit_applied. we can aggregate per-tenant and per-route.
Julia: are we okay adding two extra metrics to the hot path? worried about cardinality — maybe sample 1% for full breakdown and compute estimates.
Prateek: sampling ok if we provide confidence bands. do we have a service to compute uplifted estimates? cost pipeline could incorporate sample rate.
Lisa: UX: show 'estimate based on 1% sample' badge and tla for confidence.
Matt: API question: should the console call new /metrics/cost-rollup? we need an API that accepts window, group_by=[tenant,route,model,quantized] and sample_rate.
Samir: proto: POST /internal/cost/rollup {window_from, window_to, group_by, include_cache_credit:true, sample_rate:0.01}
Anya: we should default sample_rate to 0.5% to limit telemetry. also require caller to be internal console service.
billing-bot: :information_source: New schema change: cost_rollup.v2 added fields 'sample_rate' and 'cache_credit_applied' — migration planned 03/15.
Julia: ops question: how big will the storage blowup be? storing sample payloads vs aggregated counters?
Prateek: plan: keep only aggregates hourly, store raw sampled payloads for 7 days for debugging.
Lisa: rollout plan: behind feature flag per-org, start with 5 beta tenants, then expand.
Anya: can we add per-model unit economics card showing effective cost/token at current quantization and batch sizes? very useful for product teams.
Matt: yes, add a 'model-efficiency' view. we need a join of per-model throughput, avg_seq_len, quantization_factor, and unit_cost.
Samir: quick query snippet for metrics service:
```
SELECT tenant_id, model, SUM(tokens*unit_price) as raw_cost, SUM(cache_credit) as cache_credit
FROM invocation_samples
WHERE ts BETWEEN $start AND $end
GROUP BY tenant_id, model;
```
Lisa: tidy. let's track a small experiment: 5 tenants for two weeks and check delta between sampled estimates vs actual billing.
Anya: next steps: Samir to add proto & metrics plumbing; Prateek to add estimator that uplifts samples; Julia to size storage; Lisa to draft console mockups; Matt to wire API auth checks.
Matt: +1. timeline: aim for beta flag ready in 2 sprints.
Prateek: will add confidence intervals in estimator — final deliverable will include p50/p95 burn.
billing-bot: :white_check_mark: Migration scheduled for 2026-04-10 02:00 UTC (no downtime expected).
Anya: thanks all. I'll post the UX mocks in #product when ready.
